specialistPrompt.title: Use Spare Powder?
specialistPrompt.body: Reveal your power to take back your Quickdraw. Choose a powder to discard in its place.

toughPrompt.title: Use Phantom Pain?
toughPrompt.body: Reveal your power to take a share this round, despite being struck or yielding.

insaneReveal.confirmBody: You can't un-reveal. If anyone wounds you this round, every still-standing crewmate goes down with you.

six_feet_under.name: Davy Jones's Cut
six_feet_under.description: Shareholder of the undertakers. Earn $10,000 for each crewmate killed during the voyage.

unbreakable.name: Ironhide
unbreakable.description: You're only killed when you take a fourth wound.

dragon_skin.name: Krakenscale
dragon_skin.description: You can only be wounded once per round, no matter how many shots land.

super_coward.name: Yellow-Belly's Purse
super_coward.description: Each shame marker grants you $5,000 instead of costing it.

specialist.name: Spare Powder
specialist.description: After playing your Quickdraw, take it back and discard an unused powder instead. One use.

tough.name: Phantom Pain
tough.description: Take a split share even if you were struck or yielded this round. One use.

insane.name: Pocket Inferno
insane.description: Reveal early to brandish your grenade. If any wound lands on you this round, it explodes — every still-standing crewmate takes a wound and the round ends. One use.

the_kid.name: Dead Eye
the_kid.description: Lock in your powder now, but call your mark after every other gun is leveled.

the_cunning.name: Bloodhound
the_cunning.description: Lock in your mark now, but load your gun after every other gun is leveled.
